# QuestUI

> Editable pixel-art React components with shadcn-compatible source delivery, Astryx semantics, and StyleX styling.

QuestUI provides the complete 64-component shadcn catalog as editable TypeScript compositions. The CLI copies source into a consumer application; Astryx and StyleX remain dependencies.

## Documentation

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): registry hosting, CLI installation, guarded Vite setup, and component delivery.
- [Component catalog](docs/components.md): all CLI slugs, primary exports, and Astryx foundations.
- [AI integration guide](docs/ai.md): canonical files, styling invariants, change workflow, and verification contract.
- [Project README](README.md): overview, quick start, architecture, development, and current limits.

## Canonical machine-readable sources

- `cli/catalog.ts`: component names and Astryx mappings.
- `components/quest/index.ts`: public exports.
- `public/r/registry.json`: generated shadcn-compatible registry metadata.
- `package.json`: package entry points, binary, scripts, versions, and engine requirements.
